body:
## Council question

Can Vladimir's Spite swap cards from the Supplies cache?

## Why this needs a ruling

The live Harkonnen sheet says Supplies cards cannot be swapped with Spite. The production Supplies description says they can be spited. These statements conflict within current production.

## Answer needed

Confirm whether cache cards are eligible for Spite and distinguish the Supplies trigger card from the four temporary cache cards.

## Provisional drafting approach

Follow the faction-sheet prohibition only provisionally; align both published texts after the ruling.

This is a research question, not an adopted ruling or a claim that Norbert has answered it. No answer has been supplied yet. Keep the affected rules provisional until Norbert or the council confirms them.

## Sources

[Live Harkonnen](https://dune.zone/factions/house-harkonnen); [Supplies](https://dune.zone/assets/card-treachery/supplies); [Supplies cache](https://dune.zone/assets/deck/supplies-cache).

Part of #1831. Record the confirmed answer, its date and a worked example here before closing. Norbert will share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.
title: Dreamrules ruling: Can Vladimir's Spite swap cards from the Supplies cache?
